description: This file defines a React component named DashboardLayout for structuring dashboard pages, along with related sub-components KPICard and ChartPlaceholder, which are intended for an admin, HR, or employee dashboard interface. It primarily imports React and some custom UI components, and exports functions to render layout elements.

methods.name: DashboardLayout({ title, subtitle, actions, children })
methods.description: Shared layout component for dashboards with headers, sidebar, and main content area.

methods.name: KPICard({ label, value, accent })
methods.description: A card component displaying a KPI label and value, with optional accent styling.

methods.name: ChartPlaceholder({ title = 'Chart', height = 220 })
methods.description: A placeholder component for charts with a title and fixed height.

ctags.name: DashboardLayout
ctags.pattern: /^export default function DashboardLayout({ title, subtitle, actions, children }) {$/
